_doc: OPTIONAL GATES, on top of profiles.registration.json (identical apart
from this block and this note). Supplying a check does not make it
mandatory; this file is the separate decision that does. Inactive.
member and acceptance require the full backend suite; integration and
acceptance also require the docs build and a Bench review verdict of
APPROVE bound to the exact head (review: bench). bench records which
run reviewed; it does NOT establish that the reviewer is independent of
the author, and separate-reviewer is not used because one GitHub
account cannot formally review its own pull request.
bench-browser is deliberately not required: on a host whose Chromium
cannot start its sandbox it is a setup error every time, and a gate on
it would refuse every merge. Add it once a host has shown it passing.
Evidence must be bound to a clean committed head: commit, then ask.
